projectGates.summary: No em dash (U+2014) in UI microcopy or skill text.
No fabricated stats, testimonials, AI avatars or unverified security claims.
No dead links, buttons or navbar anchors.
No UI features implemented by scripts that patch source or CSS with string replacement.
No eyebrow capsule badges or floating pill banners above headlines.
No generic template layouts such as hero plus three cards.
Deliver a PASS/FAIL report with interactive verification, guard exit codes and a purpose log.

skills.name: racepulse-launch-seo

deferredTopics.topic: Kubernetes, Helm Charts, Service Discovery, Terraform
deferredTopics.reason: The stack is Firebase managed hosting and Functions plus the local Windows Timing Station. Revisit only if workloads move to containers.

deferredTopics.topic: Sharding, Partitioning, Leader Election, CAP Theorem, Distributed Transactions, Saga Pattern
deferredTopics.reason: Firestore handles distribution and partitioning automatically. Concurrency and cloud/LAN conflict resolution are covered in racepulse-data-integrity.

deferredTopics.topic: Load Balancing, Reverse Proxies, API Gateways, Docker, Autoscaling, Horizontal and Vertical Scaling
deferredTopics.reason: Managed by Firebase Hosting and Cloud Functions (with maxInstances caps covered in racepulse-delivery-performance).

deferredTopics.topic: Garbage Collection, Thread Safety, Connection Pooling, TCP vs UDP, gRPC
deferredTopics.reason: Low relevance to a browser SPA plus Node.js Functions. Revisit only if the C# rfid-bridge service expands into multi-threaded socket pooling.
